body: Sankaran Naren, CIO (equity) of ICICI Prudential AMC, India's best-known institutional contrarian. Process: buy what has underperformed and is out of favour; shift between equity, debt and gold based on valuation (the house Balanced Advantage approach raises equity when valuations are low and cuts it when high - characterisation of the model); stress-test with history (the 1994-2004 'lost decade' in Indian mid/small caps). Documented calls: Feb 2025 (IFA Galaxy) - said median P/E of mid/small caps at ~43x was 'absurd' and unsustainable, more expensive than 2008, and questioned SIPs/fresh money in those categories; by then the Smallcap 250 had already fallen ~24% from its Sept 2024 peak, and it lagged through 2025. Aug 2025 - warned of 1990s-like risk. Feb 2026 - 'mega gains are unlikely now', large caps not meaningfully overvalued, small/mid caps significantly overvalued. Mistake/limitation: his caution on small caps started in 2023, and small caps rallied hard through Sept 2024 before falling - valuation-based calls are directionally useful but early (characterisation). Copyable: a rule-based allocation that lowers equity (especially small caps) as median P/E and IPO froth rise, and adds after 1-2 years of underperformance; pair with lump-sum deployment into large caps when they are unloved.

body: Flag: MIXED (operations strong; family/holdco governance contested). Bharat Forge is a global forging leader with defence/aero growth and long dividend record; no promoter pledging noted. Governance concerns are about the family and holding structure: (1) Hikal ownership dispute -- the Kalyani and Hiremath families each own ~34% of Hikal; Baba Kalyani's sister Sugandha Hiremath (Bombay HC, Mar-2023) claims a 1993-94 family arrangement obliges Baba to sell his Hikal stake to her family; Baba calls it a non-binding 'note'. (2) Brother Gaurishankar Kalyani disputes their mother Sulochana Kalyani's will (2024); nephews/nieces filed a Pune civil suit (2024) claiming shares of group assets. (3) The Supreme Court appointed former judge L. Nageswara Rao as mediator (Jul-2026), listing the matter for 3-Aug-2026 -- outcome not found. (4) Holdco structure (Kalyani Investment, BF Investment, Kalyani Steels) trades at deep holdco discounts; Bharat Forge has invested in group companies and new ventures (EVs, defence, US aluminium plants) whose returns lagged. Earlier, a 2024 news report of an alleged conspiracy complaint by Hiremath's side was denied by the Baba Kalyani group (allegation). No SEBI/ED findings against the promoters found. Investor read: discount the holdcos; watch board stability and any forced stake sale at Hikal.

data.red_flags: multi-front family disputes; holdco discount; capital spread into ventures
